messages:
Sam - Sales: Heads up — prospect asks if Redwood can both accept BYO-HSM keys and perform rotations on their behalf on a 4-hour cadence. They also want an auditable signed event for each rotation and clarity on any incremental costs. Can we confirm what's feasible and a quick cost stub?
Eli - Solutions Eng: Feasible. Two integration modes: 1) Proxy -> Redwood calls into CloudHSM/customer HSM; 2) Remote-unwrap via short-lived ephemeral key (more complex). For managed rotations we implement a signed rotation API + produce an attested audit event. Need to know whether they require dual-custody ceremonies.
Sam - Sales: Customer says dual-custody for initial import only, but wants Redwood to run periodic rotations and produce signed attestations. They specifically asked: "who signs the rotation event, where logs are stored, and whether Redwood ever sees plaintext KEK"
Priya - Security: Quick answers: Redwood must never persist plaintext KEK. Rotation events are signed by our rotation-service key (we can optionally include HSM attestation blobs). Logs stored in encrypted audit store with export as encrypted bundle. We'll need to confirm FIPS/CC standards they require. Also SOW must mention we operate under customer authorization when we rotate BYO keys.
Diego - SRE: Implementation notes: expose POST /v1/keys/:id/rotate with actor metadata. Workflow: lock keyid -> call HSM rotate/derive -> update unwrap endpoint -> flush kvcache -> emit signed event to audit stream. Latency note: proxied unwrap adds ~20ms typical, up to 60ms worst-case if HSM in different region. For 4-hour rotations, we should pre-warm instances to avoid tokenization stalls.
Eli - Solutions Eng: Suggested customer-facing options to send: 
- Self-managed: Customer calls our rotate API or runs their own rotation; Redwood verifies attestation and stores signed event. No ops fee beyond base integration.
- Managed rotations: Redwood executes rotations on behalf of customer, signs attestation, delivers audit bundle. Managed tiers: Basic (business hours execution), Extended (24/7 scheduling + up to N rotations/mo included), Emergency (on-call front-of-line).
Sam - Sales: They prefer Managed rotations (Redwood executes). Can you draft a short SOW paragraph and ballpark pricing? They want numbers for procurement.
Priya - Security: SOW paragraph (sendable): "Redwood will perform cryptographic key rotations for customer-provided KMS/HSM keys upon customer request or scheduled cadence. Redwood will not persist plaintext KEK material; cryptographic operations will be executed directly against the tenant-controlled HSM. For each rotation Redwood will publish a signed rotation event and include HSM attestation artifacts. Customer will authorize Redwood to execute rotations under the terms of an addendum that limits scope, requires prescribed escalation contacts, and specifies audit log retention and export requirements."
Eli - Solutions Eng: Pricing stub: 
- One-time integration & security review: 40 hours (engineering) + 8 hours (security) = ~48 hours.
- Managed rotation service: Basic: $2,000/month (business-hours rotations, up to 8 rotations/mo).
  Extended: $6,000/month (24/7 scheduled rotations, up to 50 rotations/mo).
  Emergency on-call: $1,200/incident beyond plan or overtime multiplier 1.5x for nights/weekends.
- Additional: Data egress for attestation bundles billed at standard egress rates; optional long-term audit export $X/month.
Diego - SRE: Ops constraints to flag to customer: if HSM is on-prem, network firewalling/NAT and runbook access windows needed. Rotation runs will require a short window for KV cache invalidation — we recommend a <30s coordination window. We'll include a rollback path if unwraps fail.
ops-bot: runbook-deploy: feature/rotation-managed -> staging succeeded (2026-03-18T16:22:10Z)
Sam - Sales: Perfect. Two follow-ups: 1) they want a guarantee that Redwood's rotation will not increase 99th pct latency beyond a given threshold during rotation — can we provide an SLI? 2) they want to know if rotations triggered during a weekend blackout incur premium.
Diego - SRE: For SLI, we can guarantee 99th tail increase <= 75ms for proxied HSM when HSM is in same cloud region; otherwise we provide measured numbers after staging sim. We'll include automatic fallback routing to a compatible model variant during rotation. For blackout: yes, rotations outside business hours subject to overtime pricing (1.5x) unless on Extended plan which covers 24/7.
Priya - Security: Tag legal and compliance: prepare BYO-HSM addendum and confirm retention/encryption obligations for exported audit bundles. Also confirm export-control country list for on-prem HSMs.
Sam - Sales: I'll send this to the customer and attach the SOW paragraph + pricing stub. Please DM me quick one-line confirmations for integration hours and emergency pricing. Need to close by EOD. :clipboard:
